{{Quote|In the Old Republic, Jedi Knights were the protectors and guardians of all. For a thousand generations the Jedi used the powers of the Force to guide, defend, and provide support for the rightful government of worlds&mdash;before the dark days of the Empire came, and the Jedi Knights were killed.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>}}
The following events took place in approximately '''24,953 BBY''', also known as '''BTC 21,300'''.

==Events==
*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] make contact with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haune Tiar]] accompanies the scouts back to the Republic. After conferring for several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], the Order pledge themselves to the Republic's service.<ref name="History 12">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 12: The Birth of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="Date">[[Timeline 15: The Jedi Join the Republic]] provides 21,300 BTC as the date when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] began in [[5000 BBY]], which is 1,347 BTC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', so the difference between the calendar based on the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the calendar based on the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] is 3,653 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This allows to place the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] joining the Republic in [[24,953 BBY]].</ref>
